title: Vamya Gui Lol
script:
-- VamyaGuiLol Panel for Delta Executor (Music Updated)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Защита от дублирования интерфейса
local oldGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("VamyaGuiLol")
if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local disco = Instance.new("TextButton")
local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local TextLabel_2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local skybox = Instance.new("TextButton")
local music2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
local particlesspam = Instance.new("TextButton")
local musicstop = Instance.new("TextButton")
local jumpscare2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
local decalspam = Instance.new("TextButton")
local jumpscare1 = Instance.new("TextButton")
local hint = Instance.new("TextButton")

-- Константы ID ресурсов
local IMAGE_ASSET = "rbxassetid://111762148290450"
local MUSIC_ASSET = "rbxassetid://104835515231080" -- Новый ID музыки из вашего запроса

-- Настройки ScreenGui
ScreenGui.Name = "VamyaGuiLol"
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Главный фрейм (Голубая неоновая тема)
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 22, 36)
Frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 255)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 4
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.25, 0)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 270)
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true -- Нативное перетаскивание для Delta Mobile

-- Текстовые заголовки панели
TextLabel.Parent = Frame
TextLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1.000
TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.04, 0)
TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30)
TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
TextLabel.Text = "VamyaGuiLol"
TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255)
TextLabel.TextSize = 28.000

TextLabel_2.Parent = Frame
TextLabel_2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TextLabel_2.BackgroundTransparency = 1.000
TextLabel_2.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.14, 0)
TextLabel_2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 20)
TextLabel_2.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansItalic
TextLabel_2.Text = "Delta Fixed Core"
TextLabel_2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 240, 255)
TextLabel_2.TextSize = 16.000

-- Функция для стилизации кнопок в голубой гамме
local function styleButton(btn, text, pos, size)
    btn.Parent = Frame
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 38, 60)
    btn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 255)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 2
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.Size = size
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.TextSize = 14.000
    btn.TextWrapped = true
end

-- Расстановка кнопок
styleButton(decalspam, "Decal Spam", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.32, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 26))
styleButton(skybox, "Skybox Change", UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0.32, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 26))
styleButton(hint, "Show Hint", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.46, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 26))
styleButton(jumpscare1, "Jumpscare 1", UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0.46, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 26))
styleButton(disco, "Disco Mode", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.60, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 26))
styleButton(jumpscare2, "Jumpscare 2", UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0.60, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 26))
styleButton(music2, "Play Music", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.74, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 22))
styleButton(musicstop, "Stop Music", UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0.74, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 22))
styleButton(particlesspam, "Particles Spam", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.86, 0), UDim2.new(0, 208, 0, 28))

-- ЛОГИКА КНОПОК

-- 1. Дискотека
disco.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    task.spawn(function()
        local ColorCorrection = Lighting:FindFirstChild("ColorCorrection") or Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
        local function zigzag(X) return math.acos(math.cos(X * math.pi)) / math.pi end
        local Counter = 0
        Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00"
        while task.wait(0.1) do
            local color = Color3.fromHSV(zigzag(Counter), 1, 1)
            ColorCorrection.TintColor = color
            Lighting.Ambient = color
            Counter = Counter + 0.01
        end
    end)
end)

-- 2. Смена Скайбокса
skybox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, oldSky in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if oldSky:IsA("Sky") then oldSky:Destroy() end
    end
    local s = Instance.new("Sky")
    s.Name = "Sky"
    s.SkyboxBk = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxDn = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxFt = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxLf = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxRt = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxUp = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.Parent = Lighting
    Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00"
end)

-- 3. Включение фоновой музыки с новым ID
music2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.Parent = Workspace
    sound.SoundId = MUSIC_ASSET
    sound.Playing = true
    sound.Looped = true
    sound.Volume = 3
end)

-- 4. Летающие частицы (Спавнятся на вашей голове)
particlesspam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character and character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        local emit = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        emit.Parent = character.Head
        emit.Texture = IMAGE_ASSET
        emit.VelocitySpread = 360
        emit.Speed = NumberRange.new(15, 30)
        emit.Rate = 120
        emit.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
    end
end)

-- 5. Стоп музыка
musicstop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Sound") then obj:Stop() end
    end
end)

-- 6. Функция полноэкранных скримеров
local function triggerLocalJumpscare(soundId)
    if LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") then
        local targetGui = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
        if not targetGui:FindFirstChild("Screamer") then
            task.spawn(function()
                local newgui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", targetGui)
                newgui.Name = "Screamer"
                newgui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                
                local newimage = Instance.new("ImageLabel", newgui)
                newimage.Image = IMAGE_ASSET
                newimage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                newimage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                newimage.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                newimage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                newimage.ZIndex = 99999
                
                local s = Instance.new("Sound", newgui)
                s.SoundId = soundId
                s.Volume = 10
                s.Looped = true
                s:Play()
                
                task.wait(6)
                newgui:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
end

jumpscare2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    triggerLocalJumpscare("rbxassetid://613960902")
end)

jumpscare1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    triggerLocalJumpscare("rbxassetid://8280196339")
end)

-- 7. Спам декалей по всей карте
decalspam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local function exPro(root)
        for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= IMAGE_ASSET then
                v.Parent = nil
            elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
                v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
                v.Transparency = 0
                for _, face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
                    local decal = Instance.new("Decal", v)
                    decal.Texture = IMAGE_ASSET
                    decal.Face = face
                end
            end
            exPro(v)
        end
    end
    exPro(Workspace)
end)

-- 8. Хинт / Уведомление на экране в стиле VamyaGui
hint.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local hintGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", hintGui)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
    label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    label.TextScaled = true
    label.Text = "Welcome to VamyaGuiLol loaded successfully!"
    task.delay(4, function() hintGui:Destroy() end)
end)
